about: A synthetic mid-size Australian financial services firm piloting coding and support agents. Not a real organisation.
concerns: How does agent-to-agent (A2A) authorisation work, and how do we stop one agent acting with another agent's permissions?
What gateway do we need in front of models and MCP tools?
Can prompts, outputs and agent memory stay in Australia?
How do we make a person approve an agent action before it runs, with evidence of who approved it?
